name: Schedule Trigger
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Schedule Trigger node to run workflows at fixed intervals and times. This works in a similar way to the Cron software utility in Unix-like systems

parameters.name: Hours trigger interval
parameters.description: For example, if you enter 6 Hours Between Triggers and 30 Trigger at Minute, the node will run every six hours at 30 minutes past the hour
options: Hours Between Triggers: Enter the number of hours between each workflow trigger

parameters.name: Days trigger interval
parameters.description: For example, if you enter 2 Days Between Triggers, 9am for Trigger at Hour, and 15 Trigger at Minute, the node will run every two days at 9:15am
options: Days Between Triggers: Enter the number of days between each workflow trigger
Trigger at Hour: Select the hour of the day to trigger the node

parameters.name: Weeks trigger interval
parameters.description: For example, if you enter 2 Weeks Between Triggers, Monday for Trigger on Weekdays, 3pm for Trigger at Hour, and 30 Trigger at Minute, the node will run every two weeks on Monday at 3:30 PM
options: Weeks Between Triggers: Enter the number of weeks between each workflow trigger
Trigger on Weekdays: Select the day(s) of the week you want to trigger the node
Trigger at Hour: Select the hour of the day to trigger the node

parameters.name: Months trigger interval
parameters.description: For example, if you enter 3 Months Between Triggers, 28 Trigger at Day of Month, 9am for Trigger at Hour, and 0 Trigger at Minute, the node will run each quarter on the 28th day of the month at 9:00 AM
options: Trigger at Hour: Select the hour of the day to trigger the node

parameters.name: Custom (Cron) interval
parameters.description: Enter a custom cron Expression to set the schedule for the trigger

parameters.name: Why there are six asterisks in the Cron expression
parameters.description: The sixth asterisk in the Cron expression represents seconds. Setting this is optional. The node will execute even if you don't set the value for seconds

parameters.name: If Execution Is Missed
parameters.description: What to do with missed executions. Choose from:

parameters.name: Missed Execution Grace Period (Seconds)
parameters.description: How late an execution may start before it counts as missed. Set to 0 to use the instance setting (N8N_SCHEDULER_MISFIRE_GRACE, 60 seconds by default). n8n raises values below the instance minimum (60 seconds with the defaults) to it, and caps values above 30 days

common_issues.title: Invalid cron expression
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when you set Trigger Interval to Custom (Cron) and n8n doesn't understand your cron expression. This may mean that there is a mistake in your cron expression or that you're using an incompatible syntax

common_issues.title: Scheduled workflows run at the wrong time
common_issues.summary: If the Schedule Trigger node runs at the wrong time, it may mean that you need to adjust the time zone n8n uses

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName:
This workflow will run on the schedule you define here once you publish it.

For testing, you can also trigger it manually: by going back to the canvas and clicking 'execute workflow'

values.name: notice
values.displayName: You can find help generating your cron expression here
